decisions.reason: KiCad-version-specific 3D-model path compatibility does not change the required BOM contents or assembly part-number rules.
The path-variable decision does not alter component availability, alternative-part, or procurement policies.
Portable 3D-model references do not change the requirement to validate component orientations in the JLCPCB assembly configuration.
The source decision concerns local KiCad model references and does not change the actors, method, grouping, or missing-part handling for JLCPCB orders.
KiCad 8 and KiCad 9 path-variable compatibility does not affect the QR-code marking requirement.
The requirement to use through-hole connectors remains unchanged by the 3D-model reference strategy.
The source decision does not alter the lead-free manufacturing constraint.
The required Gerber, drill, and pick-and-place exports remain unchanged; the source only constrains packaged KiCad 3D-model references.
The connector-pin silkscreen labels are independent of KiCad third-party 3D-model path variables.
The power-board dimensions, orientation, mounting holes, and connector clearances are not changed by project asset portability.
The enclosure's accommodation, mounting, airflow, assembly, and retention requirements remain valid without modification.
The battery connector family, pitch, pin count, and electrical functions are unaffected by KiCad-version-specific model-reference paths.
